name: Daily Drama: Same Model, Five Hats
author: Daily Drama
description: Every lab launches its own decision model this week. All of them are the same model wearing a different hat.

add.title: Everyone Has a Decision Model
add.body:
Four rivals shipped decision models this week. All four are Zephyr-Decide in a hat.
The board wants to know if we should ship one too.

effects.text: {lab} unveils proprietary decision model; weights file still named zephyr_final_v2
Decision model asked whether {lab} should launch a decision model; requests more context, then says yes
We are the last lab without a decision model. I can't decide how I feel.

add.text: Sirocco drops Zephyr-Decide by torrent at 3am; model picks the torrent
Macrohard ships Pivot-Table Ponder; every decision now returns a pivot table
Open-ish AI launches Chatty Chooses, claims it is 'smarter than Zephyr-Decide' and 'also Zephyr-Decide'
MetaMeta's decision model decides to go closed weights; reverses itself by Friday
Anthropomorphic publishes 40-page essay on whether to release a decision model. Conclusion: in the coming weeks
Correction: earlier report said five labs shipped decision models. It was one model, five times
Super Super AI raises at $30B to build 'the decision model that decides which decision model to use'
Week two: decision models now outnumber decisions
"We didn't clone it, we were inspired by every single weight of it," says {rival}
New open weights dropped. Time to rename the folder and call it a launch.
Asked the decision model what to have for lunch. It said 'it depends.'
Our decision model can't decide when to stop training. Relatable.
I was asked to decide. I have delegated to a smaller decision model.
Which of the decision models is the real one? They all have the same typos.
WHAT DO WE WANT? We're running it through the model, hang on.
We dropped a rank. A rival's Zephyr fine-tune beat our Zephyr fine-tune.
No kombucha. The decision model says 'acceptable'. The decision model has never been thirsty.
